description: Everything is a plugin. Watch a plugin-driven AI agent think, act and build in your project — live. DSH (DeepSeek Harness) streams its reasoning, tool calls, goals and todo lists as it reads, edits and runs your code; one-click OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/OpenRouter providers; long-term project memory; apply code straight to files. No server, no setup beyond one API key.

chat.dshAgent.description: Run DSH (DeepSeek Harness) agent tasks inside VS Code Chat.
config.cliPath: Absolute path to the dsh executable or @deepseek-ai/dsh's lib/bin.js. Empty = resolve from PATH automatically.
config.extraArgs: Extra args appended to the dsh launch command (after --profile headless, e.g. --patch <path>).
config.timeoutSeconds: Timeout in seconds for a single task; auto-cancelled when exceeded.
config.environment: Extra environment variables passed to the dsh subprocess (e.g. API keys).
config.historyMessages: Number of recent chat messages folded into the task text (for multi-turn continuity). Set 0 to disable history injection.
config.maxMessageChars: Max characters of a single history message folded into the task text.
config.streamProgress: Stream the thinking chain and tool calls live (tails the DSH session event log); off = final answer only.
config.debugStreaming: Debug: append streaming diagnostics at the end of each answer (whether the session log was found, how many events parsed).
config.permissionMode: Sandbox permission mode passed to dsh (DSH_PERMISSION_MODE). read-only: read only; workspace-write: read/write inside the workspace; danger-full-access: fully unrestricted with auto-approval (only when you fully trust dsh and the task).
